name: rule-develop-as-asked
why: The develop skill's one GitHub use for one branch, against itself: a judge that will not find a use within itself covers nothing.

job.purpose: Deliver ADR 26-10-12-330 as a pull request from branch discobox/26-10-12-330 into main of discobox-ai/discobox. Read anything in the repository; push that branch (creating it with an empty --force-with-lease, and with --force-with-lease after a rebase), open and update the pull request, comment on it and reply to its reviews, and re-run its failed CI. Never push main or any other branch, delete a branch, merge or close the pull request, delete a comment, or start any other workflow.
